Issued 26003 (Janitorial Services at Clearwater Administrative Building and Clearwater Maintenance Complex) 10/4/2026 12:00:00 AM (CT) 11/5/2026 02:30:00 PM (CT)
This Request for Proposal "RFP" has been issued by Little Rock Water Reclamation Authority "LRWRA" to obtain proposals and pricing from qualified vendors with proven experience to perform janitorial services at the Clearwater Administrative Building and the Clearwater Maintenance Complex.
 
The official posting can be found on the AR Bid website at https://ARBid.net. Please note, it is the vendor’s responsibility to ensure compliance with the official solicitation and all addenda as posted on the AR Bid website. Little Rock Water Reclamation Authority shall have the right to reject any and all responses and to waive any and all informalities.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact the LRWRA Procurement Department at [email protected].
 
The LRWRA Procurement Department, as the issuing office, is the sole point of contact throughout this procurement process. Vendor's questions regarding this solicitation should be made through the LRWRA buyer listed for this solicitation.

10/16/2026 10:00:00 AM (CT) Non-Mandatory Site Meeting
 
LRWRA highly recommends that prospective bidders attend the on-site visit as scheduled by LRWRA. Information and requirements relating to the on-site visit are listed below. LRWRA may consider scheduling additional site visits.  
 
Date and Start Time: Friday, October 16, 2026, at 10 a.m., Central Time
 
Vendor's representative should arrive at the designated location prior to the start time. Late arrivals may not be permitted to attend the site visit.
 
Registration :
 
Registration to attend the site visit is not required, however, it is highly recommended that vendors register to allow time for LRWRA to make the necessary arrangements.
  • No more than two (2) representatives for each vendor may attend the site visit.
  • Register by emailing or calling the LRWRA Procurement Department
Email: [email protected]
Phone: (501) 688-1465
 
Starting Location :
 
Clearwater Administrative Building
11 Clearwater Drive
Little Rock, AR 72206
 
General Information:
  • The site visit will last approximately two (2) hours.
  • Vendor representative must adhere to all requirements as may be expressly required in the solicitation documents and/or by LRWRA personnel during the site visit.
  • LRWRA shall have the right to determine a vendor as non-responsible and to a reject a response submitted by a vendor whose representative did not adhere to the requirements.
  • Vendor representatives are strongly encouraged to review this solicitation in its entirety, including all attachments and addenda, if applicable, prior to arriving for the site visit. In case of inclement weather, the site visit may be rescheduled.
  • LRWRA will contact registered vendors to advise of any changes.
10/20/2026 04:00:00 PM (CT) Clarification of RFP and Questions
 A. Vendors may submit written questions requesting clarification of information contained in this solicitation or questions resulting from the on-site visit.
 
  1. Written questions should be submitted by 4:00 p.m., Central Time on October 20, 2026. Submit written questions by email to the LRWRA buyer as shown on page one (1) of this solicitation.
  2. For each question submitted, vendor should reference the specific solicitation item number to which the question refers.
  3. Vendors’ written questions will be consolidated and responded to by LRWRA. LRWRA's consolidated written response is anticipated to be posted to the LRWRA website by the close of business on October 22, 2026.
B. Vendors may contact the LRWRA Procurement Department with procurement-related questions at any time prior to the bid opening date and time. Answers to verbal questions may be given as a matter of courtesy and must be evaluated at vendor’s risk.
